LESSON: CLASS LEADERSHIP

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social
Topic 2.1.8: Class Leadership

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Class Leadership. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe a good class leader
2. outline the work of a good class leader
3. appreciate good class leadership for harmonious living. guardians about good leaders in the community and report back.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe a good class leader
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to describe a good class leader. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. outline the work of a good class leader
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to outline the work of a good class leader. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate good class leadership for harmonious living. guardians about good leaders in the community and report back.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate good class leadership for harmonious living. guardians about good leaders in the community and report back. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Class Leadership.
2. Explain Class Leadership to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should discuss “who is a good class leader? class leader class leader”? c) appreciate good class
4. Show that you can: describe a good class leader
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Class Leadership. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Class Leadership important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss “who is a good class leader? class leader class leader”? c) appreciate good class
2. Discuss the work a class leadership for harmonious leader living.
3. Find out from parents or guardians about good leaders in the community and report back.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. describe a good class leader
2. outline the work of a good class leader
3. appreciate good class leadership for harmonious living. guardians about good leaders in the community and report back.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
